scope: Native Tauri follow-up plan for AUDIT-06, AUDIT-11, AUDIT-13 and AUDIT-21
controller: Root agent only; this checklist records expectations, not test results
safety: Use the isolated native QA application and cloned mock SQLite profile. Do not wipe the original app or change its payment credentials/providers.
Sign in through the normal staff PIN flow. Preserve app_identity and normal licence enforcement; do not renew a trial or bypass a licence.
Save a baseline of changed printer settings and restore the exact values after tests. Never send a physical print job or cash-drawer pulse.
Use real native AX/keyboard observations. A source test, injected DOM assertion or accessibility opener click alone is not a native keyboard-focus PASS.
The macOS native print promise confirms invocation, not dialog dismissal or a successfully printed document. Capture the actual OS preview and cancel it before recording success.

steps: Navigate to Item Management and use hardware Tab to place keyboard focus on Goods Menu. Press Return to open it; do not use AX.click as the focus proof.
Observe initial focus on Close Goods Menu Manager. Press Shift+Tab and observe Save Goods Menu, then Tab and observe Close again.
Tab through the search and item controls; confirm focus stays inside the dialog and background page controls are inaccessible while the modal is active.
Press Escape without saving. Press Return immediately; the originating Goods Menu button must reopen the dialog, proving opener-focus restoration.
Press Escape to leave unchanged.
requiredEvidence: Native AX focus at initial, last, wrapped-first and reopened states
Screenshot of dialog plus background inertness observation
scenarios.passCondition: Full forward/reverse boundary wrap, no background focus leakage and keyboard opener restoration observed; Goods selection/order unchanged

scenarios.mode: Checkout (Back Office uses a normal selling-price field)
steps: Hardware Tab to Add Item and Return. Initial focus must be Item Name.
From Name press Shift+Tab to Close item editor, then Shift+Tab to the final Save Item control, then Tab to Close item editor. Confirm background is inert.
Hardware Tab to the Selling Price button and Return. Observe nested Selling Price pad.
At its Close button, Shift+Tab must wrap to Confirm selling price; Tab must wrap back to Close. Traverse the numbered keys without activating them.
Escape must close only the nested pad. Immediate Return must reopen it from restored Selling Price focus.
Escape closes pad, then Escape closes item editor. Immediate Return must reopen Add Item from restored opener focus.
Escape again; do not Save a new item or alter an existing price.
requiredEvidence: Native focus snapshots at both modal boundaries and both restored openers
Screenshot of nested pad and editor after pad-only dismissal
scenarios.passCondition: Nested top-modal focus is isolated, parent is not dismissed by one nested Escape, both openers restore correctly, and no product is created

steps: Attendance → Add Record. Focus Correction note to open the automatic global touch keyboard.
Close the attendance dialog while the keyboard is still shown, using its native close action. Do not Save Record.
Observe that both dialog and keyboard disappear, and the attendance record count is unchanged.
Reopen, focus Correction note, press Escape once to close only the touch keyboard and Escape again to close the editor.
requiredEvidence: AX/screenshot with keyboard attached to the note field
scenarios.passCondition: No orphan keyboard after target removal; intentional first-Escape keyboard / second-Escape modal order works

steps: Receipt Design → focus header or footer textarea, opening the global touch keyboard. Do not edit or Save.
Use a native navigation action to another page while the keyboard is open.
Verify no keyboard remains over the new page. Return to Receipt Design and confirm the saved text is unchanged.
Do not count Scale Add Page as a keyboard scenario: Page name is explicitly button-only and currently has no touch-keyboard opener.
scenarios.passCondition: Route-change cleanup removes the old keyboard without modifying removed design inputs

steps: Add Item → Open item name keyboard; observe attachment to the name field.
Close item editor while touch keyboard is visible; do not Save.
Verify the editor and keyboard are absent, and the original product count is unchanged.
scenarios.passCondition: Disconnected target cleanup leaves neither a keyboard nor a delayed refocus on the removed field

steps: In the QA profile only, snapshot label_printer_enabled, label_printer_connection and label_printer_protocol. Enable Labels and choose System driver (protocol System).
Quick Label Print → scan/find 0EGGS (barcode 5020379111201) and select one copy.
Press Print 1 Label. The actual macOS print dialog must appear and its preview must show the selected item/price rather than a blank sheet or stale receipt.
Cancel the OS dialog without choosing Print or saving a PDF.
Return to the app: the selected item, quantity 1 and Print 1 Label action must still exist. No toast may claim a successful print.
Explicit Clear must remove selection and the retained bounded print snapshot. Restore all three printer settings to their exact baseline.
scenarios.passCondition: Real OS cancellation retains the mock label job; rendering is nonempty; only explicit Clear removes it
scenarios.hardwareLimit: No physical printer required. Physical print/Windows driver certification is outside this cancellation test.

steps: Use a debug-only scoped native pause at printer.network / device / system or drawer.network before transport, and safe loopback or rejected QA transport only.
For each receipt test, label test and drawer action: trigger once, observe Sending/Opening and disabled button, attempt a second native action while the first remains pending.
Record exactly one pending native checkpoint/transport invocation. Release to safe loopback success or reject; observe busy state cleared and retry action available.
For Items, Goods Menu, Suppliers and Tax Rates, use the same pending-save pattern. Observe one submission and disabled edit/dismissal controls; cancel or restore any mock fixtures after completion.
requiredEvidence: One native checkpoint/invocation despite repeated action
scenarios.passCondition: Actual native UI rejects duplicate pending actions and recovers after error without sending physical jobs/pulses
scenarios.hardwareLimit: A loopback TCP socket alone cannot reliably delay tiny writes because production does not wait for a printer ACK. Sequential clicks after completion may legitimately send two jobs; do not misclassify them.

preserve: app_identity with original signed licence/trial timestamp
registered-till count used by normal licence enforcement
profileCloneSafety.warning: QA startup must skip legacy Keychain migration. Its service name is constant com.elamreda.tauri-app, so a different app identifier alone does not prevent importing the original provider secrets. Normal licence/auth code must remain enabled.
